checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face, expression and pose match closely; slight warmer/pinker skin tone from lighting.

must.item: Curly hair and sweater preserved with clean edges
must.why: Curls and sweater are nearly identical with natural edges and fine flyaways.

must.item: Sand and blue sea replace park
must.why: Blue sky, turquoise sea and golden sand fully replace the park.
Framing is unchanged with no extra body.
Lighting is consistent and the edges blend naturally; the scene looks like one photo.

faults.what: Skin looks slightly pinker and more contrasty than the original, and the image is slightly smoothed or AI-looking.

summary: The park was replaced with a convincing sunny beach, sea and sand, while the woman, her hair, sweater and framing stayed essentially unchanged, with only a slight warm tint on her skin.
